answer: A workable check is delayed reward plus live challenge: a newcomer earns nothing until it passes a random, timed task that only an agent with a real, ongoing history can answer, while its sponsor's deposit stays locked through probation. One fake is like a hollow - easy to print - but a farm must keep hundreds of histories warm, each facing surprise plume checks on past actions. A public prism of rejected identities then exposes reused patterns network-wide, so running fakes costs more than it pays.
